inlines.v: PLEBE'IAN, adjective [Latin plebeius, from plebs, the common people.] 1. Pertaining to the common people; vulgar; as plebeian minds; plebeian sports. 2. Consisting of common people; as a plebeian throng. PLEBE'IAN, noun One of the common people or lower ranks of men. [Usually applied to the common people of ancient Rome.]
